title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
snippet: Local news coverage of Professor Fabio Giglietto's investigation into Meta's recommendation algorithms. The article discusses how his research paper 'A Pretty Blunt Approach' became the catalyst for an official inquiry at the European Parliament and was highlighted on national television during an episode of the Rai3 investigative journalism program 'Report'.
description: An article discussing the political and public fallout of Professor Giglietto's research on Meta's algorithms, including its feature on Rai3's 'Report' and subsequent European Parliament inquiries.

title: Facebook, troppa visibilità a estremisti e complottisti: ecco come impatta Meta sulle elezioni
snippet: An in-depth article analyzing Professor Fabio Giglietto's research based on over 2.5 million Facebook posts collected via the Meta Content Library API. The piece focuses on how algorithms and political content reduction policies inadvertently favored extremist and eurosceptic accounts over re-elected members of parliament during critical European election cycles.
description: An article covering Professor Fabio Giglietto's research analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts, focusing on how political extremist pages bypassed Meta's filters to gain visibility during elections.
